methodology.remainingAssetsPoint: Exact arithmetic sum of the latest located figure for each of 41 active trusts: 9 from filed annual reports/quarterly filings (FY2025 annual reports or Q1 2026 quarterly) totaling $3,966,648,769, plus 32 from credible secondary compilations of trust annual reports (mostly FY2022 as-of dates) totaling $13,076,231,337. This is a DOCUMENTED FLOOR, not a census: ~20 active trusts publish no retrievable figure and several secondary figures are dated 2021-2022, so the true current balance is higher.
methodology.remainingAssetsHigh: Upper bound consistent with: (a) ILR 'Dubious Distribution' (2018) ~$25B assets + ~$2B deferred obligations at YE2016, (b) >$1.5B of deferred obligations since funded (Honeywell $1.325B Jan 2023, RPM/Bondex, Western completed 2024), (c) net depletion of roughly $0.5B/yr since 2016, (d) PACER-only trusts carried at last-known values. Yields low-to-mid $20Bs; $22.5B is the midpoint estimate.
methodology.cumulativePayoutsPoint: Bottom-up decomposition. DOCUMENTED FLOOR: $9,381,393,128 paid inception-to-date by the 7 trusts with cumulative figures in filed reports - Manville $5,329,722,253 through 3/31/2026 (Q1 2026 quarterly report, Bankr. S.D.N.Y. Doc 4479), Western $2,238,037,573 through 12/31/2025 (22nd Annual Report, Claim Report Exhibit F, Bankr. N.D. Cal. 13-31914 Doc 1944), NARCO $904,019,504 through 12/31/2025 (FY2025 annual report, W.D. Pa. 02-20198 Doc 8521), Thorpe Insulation $433,982,311 through 12/31/2025 (16th Annual Report, Claim Report Exhibit F, Bankr. C.D. Cal. 2:07-bk-20016-BB Doc 242), Plant $191,680,841 through 12/31/2025 (14th Annual Report, Claim Report Exhibit F, Bankr. N.D. Cal. 09-31347 Doc 3050), J.T. Thorpe (CA) $189,960,646 through 12/31/2025 (20th Annual Report, Claim Report Exhibit F, Bankr. C.D. Cal. 2:02-bk-14216-BB Doc 1901), API $93,990,000 through 12/31/2025 (FY2025 annual report, Bankr. D. Minn. 05-30073-GFK). ESTIMATED REMAINDER: ~$14.62B for all other trusts, anchored on GAO-11-819 (Sept 2011) documenting $17.5B paid on 3.3M claims 1988-2010 (hard floor = cumulativePayoutsLow) plus the prior ~$6.5B 2011-2025 extrapolation from a documented 8-trust subset paying ~$591.9M (2022) and ~$561.2M (2024). The largest documented-but-unretrieved gaps (USG, PCC, Armstrong, OC/FB, WRG, B&W, Celotex) publish cumulative figures in filed annual reports sequestered on PACER - see pacer-pull-queue.json; each pull converts estimate into documented. NOTE: DII Industries publishes no inception-to-date cumulative exhibit, so its annual reports were summed bottom-up: the 12 reports freely posted at diiasbestostrust.org (FY2014-FY2025) yield a documented cash-basis claims-paid subtotal of $1,254,425,009 (Exhibit B 'Claims Disposed Of' tables, HAL + Harbison-Walker), but the FY2005-FY2013 reports are not freely retrievable (site archive begins FY2014; RECAP indexes the FY2013 report as Doc 2903 but its exhibit PDFs are not archived) - those years are queued for PACER and DII cumulativePaid stays null until the series is complete; Maremont's FY2024-FY2025 annual reports likewise report only per-year payment dollars and inception-to-date claim COUNTS (8,229 claims submitted through 12/31/2025), no cumulative dollar line. Point estimate unchanged at $24B pending those pulls; treat remainder as order-of-magnitude, not audited.
methodology.viralFiguresDebunked: '$30B remaining' traces to GAO-11-819's ~$36.8B TOTAL CAPITALIZATION of 60 trusts as of 2011 (initial funding + returns), not a current balance. GAO analyzed reports for only 47 of 60 trusts.
